::: {#exm-pue}

#### Two datacenters

@patterson2021carbon [section 2.3] give 1.58 as the average [PUE](#def-pue) of datacenters in the United States in 2018,
and 1.11 for the Google datacenter in Iowa where they trained one of their models.
For each kilowatt-hour its computers used,
the Iowa datacenter used 1.11 in all;
the other 0.11 was overhead beyond powering the computing equipment.

:::
